summary: Lead research for Charter MVP (charter fishing booking/management platform). Targets Lake Erie fishing charter operators in Ashtabula County and Geneva-on-the-Lake area who could benefit from online booking, customer management, and trip scheduling tools.

leads.fit_rationale: Ashtabula-based charter targeting walleye, steelhead, and perch. Online booking and automated customer communication would streamline their operations.

leads.organization: Lucky Strike Lake Erie Fishing Charters
leads.fit_rationale: Ashtabula charter operator emphasizing limit catches. A booking platform with weather integration and automated reminders would enhance customer experience.
Largest charter service in Geneva area with multiple boats covering Ashtabula to Port Clinton. Fleet management and multi-boat scheduling tools would be valuable.
Premier charter with locations in Port Clinton, Ashtabula, and Lorain. Centralized booking across multiple ports would improve coordination.
15+ years experience fishing Geneva area for walleye, steelhead, and perch. Customer management and repeat booking features would support their business.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add real-time availability calendar with instant booking and deposit processing.
Include weather forecast integration with trip rescheduling policies.
Create automated email/SMS reminders with meeting location and what to bring.
Add photo galleries showing past catches and happy customers.
Include customer reviews and testimonials to build trust.
Provide catch log/analytics for anglers to track their success.
Add group booking features for corporate events and parties.
Integrate with local lodging partners for package deals.

possible_issues: Charter sites need to evoke excitement and adventure—stale design may not convert.
Poor mobile experience hurts bookings made on-the-go by travelers.
Without clear pricing and availability, customers may hesitate to inquire.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Charter booking platform can be white-labeled for individual captains or multi-boat operations with custom branding and booking rules.

action_next: Merge visual-analysis findings once the screenshot report exists.
Contact Compensator and Lucky Strike charters about piloting online booking.
Reach out to DB Sport Fishing about fleet management features.
Explore partnership with Visit Ashtabula County for charter directory integration.
